mapper.select: select #{userId} as userId, ifnull(max(f.family_name), concat('家属用户', #{userId})) as familyName, ifnull(max(f.family_phone), '--') as familyPhone, ifnull(group_concat(distinct f.relation order by f.relation separator ' / '), '--') as relationSummary from biz_elderly_family f where f.user_id = #{userId}

select e.elderly_id as elderlyId, e.elderly_name as elderlyName, e.age as age, e.gender as gender, e.phone as phone, e.address as address, e.health_status as healthStatus, ( select sl.metric_type from iot_sensor_log sl where sl.elderly_id = e.elderly_id order by sl.report_time desc, sl.log_id desc limit 1 ) as latestMetricType, ( select sl.metric_value from iot_sensor_log sl where sl.elderly_id = e.elderly_id order by sl.report_time desc, sl.log_id desc limit 1 ) as latestMetricValue, ( select sl.report_time from iot_sensor_log sl where sl.elderly_id = e.elderly_id order by sl.report_time desc, sl.log_id desc limit 1 ) as latestMetricTime, ( select sl.metric_value from iot_sensor_log sl where sl.elderly_id = e.elderly_id and sl.metric_type = 'leave_bed' order by sl.report_time desc, sl.log_id desc limit 1 ) as latestBedStatus, ( select sl.report_time from iot_sensor_log sl where sl.elderly_id = e.elderly_id and sl.metric_type = 'leave_bed' order by sl.report_time desc, sl.log_id desc limit 1 ) as latestBedStatusTime, ( select sl.metric_value from iot_sensor_log sl where sl.elderly_id = e.elderly_id and sl.metric_type = 'door_status' order by sl.report_time desc, sl.log_id desc limit 1 ) as latestDoorStatus, ( select sl.report_time from iot_sensor_log sl where sl.elderly_id = e.elderly_id and sl.metric_type = 'door_status' order by sl.report_time desc, sl.log_id desc limit 1 ) as latestDoorStatusTime, ( select sl.metric_value from iot_sensor_log sl where sl.elderly_id = e.elderly_id and sl.metric_type = 'pill_status' order by sl.report_time desc, sl.log_id desc limit 1 ) as latestPillStatus, ( select sl.report_time from iot_sensor_log sl where sl.elderly_id = e.elderly_id and sl.metric_type = 'pill_status' order by sl.report_time desc, sl.log_id desc limit 1 ) as latestPillStatusTime, ifnull(( select round(avg(cast(sl.metric_value as decimal(10, 2))), 0) from iot_sensor_log sl where sl.elderly_id = e.elderly_id and sl.metric_type = 'heart_rate' and sl.report_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 24 hour) ), null) as avgHeartRate, ifnull(( select round(avg(cast(sl.metric_value as decimal(10, 2))), 0) from iot_sensor_log sl where sl.elderly_id = e.elderly_id and sl.metric_type = 'breath_rate' and sl.report_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 24 hour) ), null) as avgBreathRate, ifnull(( select count(*) from biz_alert_record ar where ar.elderly_id = e.elderly_id and ar.handle_status in ('0', '1') ), 0) as activeAlertCount, ifnull(( select count(*) from iot_sensor_log sl where sl.elderly_id = e.elderly_id and sl.metric_type = 'pill_status' and sl.metric_value = 'missed' and date(sl.report_time) = curdate() ), 0) as medicationMissedCount, ifnull(( select count(*) from iot_sensor_log sl where sl.elderly_id = e.elderly_id and sl.metric_type = 'pill_status' and sl.metric_value = 'taken' and date(sl.report_time) = curdate() ), 0) as medicationTakenCount, ifnull(( select count(*) from biz_alert_record ar where ar.elderly_id = e.elderly_id and ar.alert_type like '%药%' and date(ar.create_time) = curdate() ), 0) as medicationAlertCount, ifnull(( select round((ifnull(hr.sleep_score, 0) + ifnull(hr.activity_score, 0)) / 2) from biz_health_report hr where hr.elderly_id = e.elderly_id order by hr.report_date desc, hr.report_id desc limit 1 ), null) as latestHealthScore, ( select hr.ai_evaluation from biz_health_report hr where hr.elderly_id = e.elderly_id order by hr.report_date desc, hr.report_id desc limit 1 ) as latestEvaluation from biz_elderly e where e.elderly_id in ( select distinct f.elderly_id from biz_elderly_family f where f.user_id = #{userId} ) order by e.elderly_id asc

select ar.alert_id as alertId, ar.elderly_id as elderlyId, ar.elderly_name as elderlyName, cast(ar.alert_level as char) as alertLevel, ar.alert_type as alertType, ar.handle_status as handleStatus, ar.alert_desc as alertDesc, ar.create_time as createTime from biz_alert_record ar where ar.elderly_id in ( select distinct f.elderly_id from biz_elderly_family f where f.user_id = #{userId} ) order by ar.create_time desc, ar.alert_id desc limit 8

select hr.report_id as reportId, hr.elderly_id as elderlyId, hr.elderly_name as elderlyName, hr.report_type as reportType, hr.report_date as reportDate, hr.sleep_score as sleepScore, hr.activity_score as activityScore, round((ifnull(hr.sleep_score, 0) + ifnull(hr.activity_score, 0)) / 2) as totalScore, hr.ai_evaluation as aiEvaluation from biz_health_report hr where hr.elderly_id in ( select distinct f.elderly_id from biz_elderly_family f where f.user_id = #{userId} ) order by hr.report_date desc, hr.report_id desc limit 8

select f.id as id, f.elderly_id as elderlyId, f.elderly_name as elderlyName, f.family_name as familyName, f.family_phone as familyPhone, f.relation as relation, f.is_emergency as isEmergency from biz_elderly_family f where f.user_id = #{userId} order by case when f.is_emergency in ('1', 'Y') then 0 else 1 end, f.id asc

select date_format(sl.report_time, '%m-%d %H:%i') as timeLabel, sl.metric_type as metricType, cast(sl.metric_value as char) as metricValue from iot_sensor_log sl where sl.elderly_id = #{elderlyId} and sl.metric_type in ('heart_rate', 'breath_rate') order by sl.report_time desc, sl.log_id desc limit 24

select ar.alert_id as alertId, ar.elderly_id as elderlyId, ar.elderly_name as elderlyName, ar.alert_desc as alertDesc, ar.handle_status as handleStatus, ar.create_time as createTime from biz_alert_record ar where ar.elderly_id in ( select distinct f.elderly_id from biz_elderly_family f where f.user_id = #{userId} ) and ar.alert_type = 'sos_help' order by ar.create_time desc, ar.alert_id desc limit 5

select e.elderly_id as elderlyId, e.elderly_name as elderlyName, e.phone as phone, e.address as address from biz_elderly e where e.elderly_id = #{elderlyId} and e.elderly_id in ( select distinct f.elderly_id from biz_elderly_family f where f.user_id = #{userId} ) limit 1

select count(*) as planTotal, sum(case when ifnull(r.execute_status, '0') = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as takenTotal, sum(case when ifnull(r.execute_status, '0') = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as missedTotal, sum(case when ifnull(r.execute_status, '0') = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as pendingTotal from biz_medication_plan p left join biz_medication_record r on r.plan_id = p.plan_id and r.scheduled_date = curdate() where p.status = '0' and p.start_date <= curdate() and (p.end_date is null or p.end_date = '' or p.end_date >= curdate()) and p.elderly_id = #{elderlyId} and p.elderly_id in ( select distinct f.elderly_id from biz_elderly_family f where f.user_id = #{userId} )

select p.plan_id as planId, p.elderly_id as elderlyId, p.elderly_name as elderlyName, p.medication_name as medicationName, p.dosage as dosage, p.plan_time as planTime, ifnull(r.execute_status, '0') as executeStatus, r.actual_time as actualTime, r.source_type as sourceType, r.remark as remark from biz_medication_plan p left join biz_medication_record r on r.plan_id = p.plan_id and r.scheduled_date = curdate() where p.status = '0' and p.start_date <= curdate() and (p.end_date is null or p.end_date = '' or p.end_date >= curdate()) and p.elderly_id = #{elderlyId} and p.elderly_id in ( select distinct f.elderly_id from biz_elderly_family f where f.user_id = #{userId} ) order by p.plan_time asc, p.plan_id asc
